'''Warok''' was an [[Ewok]] who lived on the [[Endor|forest moon]] of the [[planet]] [[Endor]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Warok was created for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. They were first identified through one of the variant covers for [[Star Wars (2020) 20|''Star Wars'' (2020) 20]].
